statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard electrocardiography.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0).
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1).
Prolonged cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is indicated.
The denial reason code is PR-204.
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan.
